intended_action: One authenticated read-only GET /jobs/{job_id} for the exact first submitted RTC job per owner invocation; each observation has a distinct append-only non-Git receipt. No processing submission, retry, or product download.

provider_references.finding: The Basic API exposes GET /jobs/{job_id} with HTTP 200 job-object response. The job object carries exact ID, type, parameters, status and optional credit, name and files metadata.
Official ASF API guidance documents authenticated job queries and status/product descriptors.
Basic outputs are retained for 14 days, so a future success will need timely separate acquisition.

claim_boundary: The observer has been tested only with generated responses. It cannot release until the exact first-job submission receipt exists and a separate public-CI-bound implementation gate is published. A future SUCCEEDED status would verify service status and file count only, not acquired product bytes, pixel fitness, or a map.
